_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 2 (D4/§5) — layers a token Arcane Essence onto the Iron's Spells wizard builds' chest. Inert without Iron's Spells: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent. Gate-safe: arcane essence is the common Iron's crafting mat, never an Upgrade Orb / top-tier ink / named scroll.
